title: Concept: Backblaze B2 bucket listing in a response
description: An object listing from a B2 bucket in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The listing exposes every stored object name, which for a bank includes statement exports and identity documents whose names follow a predictable pattern.
applicability: Deployments that render an object listing from a B2 bucket into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The listing exposes every stored object name, which for a bank includes statement exports and identity documents whose names follow a predictable pattern.
